scripts.text:
[Snower]
Snoowy's sent me a bird with a message. She told me about your help...
I'll tell you a secret of the magic rings.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
斯诺维给我派了一只信鸟。她告诉了我你提供的帮助……
我来告诉你魔法戒指的秘密吧。

scripts.text:
[Snower]
Oh... is it true? You've helped my sis Sneewy? Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
哦……是真的吗？你帮了我的妹妹斯尼维？谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Snower]
Hi! Two my sisters and I are preparing gifts for the whole 3 holidays!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
你好！我和我的两个姐妹正在为三个节日准备礼物！

scripts.text:
[Snower]
They have magic power only from 8 December till 8 January.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
它们的魔力只在12月8日到1月8日之间有效。

scripts.text:
[Snower]
By the way, just put on Santa's Hat to discover their true power.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
对了，只要戴上圣诞帽，就能发现它们真正的力量。

scripts.text:
[Snower]
If you put on both rings their power would be doubled.
Have a nice day!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
如果你同时戴上两枚戒指，它们的力量就会加倍。
祝你愉快！

scripts.text: Where are your sisters?
scripts.translation: 你的姐妹们在哪里？

scripts.text: What holidays?
scripts.translation: 什么节日？

scripts.text: What gifts?
scripts.translation: 什么礼物？

scripts.text: May I help you?
scripts.translation: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Snower]
My younger sis Sneewy's left to some faraway land to prepare gifts for their poor children... I don't know where. You should ask my elder sis and her birdies.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
我的妹妹斯尼维去了某个遥远的地方，为那里的贫困儿童准备礼物……我不知道具体是哪里。你应该去问问我的姐姐和她的鸟儿们。

scripts.text:
[Snower]
My elder sis? Her name's Snoowy. She's sailed to some green island... She's talking about some gifts for dolphins or something...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
我的姐姐？她叫斯诺维。她航行去了某个绿色的岛屿……她说要给海豚之类的生物准备礼物……

scripts.text:
[Snower]
The whole three holidays? Well they come one after another!
^000080The Christmas^000000, ^FF0000Karachun^000000 and ^008000New Year Eve^000000!

[Snower]
^FF0000Karachun^000000? Heh... This is an old pagans festival. They used to celebrate it before the appearance of HNY and XMas, you know.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
^FF0000卡拉琼节^000000？嘿……这是一个古老的异教徒节日。你知道的，在新年和圣诞节出现之前，人们就庆祝这个节日了。

scripts.text:
[Snower]
My sisters say that all the gifts should look the same way. Or else some children might fight for fancy ones!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
我的姐妹们说，所有的礼物看起来都应该一样。否则有些孩子可能会为了漂亮的礼物而打架！

scripts.text:
[Snower]
Would you like me to wrap your fancy gift boxes with a gray paper?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
你想让我用灰色纸张把你那些漂亮的礼盒包装起来吗？

scripts.text: Wrap them, please!
scripts.translation: 请帮我包装！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Snower]
I don't see any gifts in fancy boxes on you...
You've got only gray boxes.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
我没看到你身上有任何装在漂亮盒子里的礼物……
你只有灰色的盒子。

scripts.text:
[Snower]
I don't see any gifts in fancy boxes on you...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
我没看到你身上有任何装在漂亮盒子里的礼物……

scripts.text:
[Snower]
*shuffle* Here you go.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
*窸窣声* 给你。

scripts.text:
[Snower]
I wish you find my sisters ASAP... They need help.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺尔]
希望你能尽快找到我的姐妹们……她们需要帮助。

scripts.text:
[Sneewy]
Hi! I'm waithing for my sister's birdy with mail...
scripts.translation:
[斯尼维]
你好！我正在等我姐姐的信鸟送来邮件……

scripts.text:
[Sneewy]
I wish I had 4 more gray Gift Boxes for native children...
scripts.translation:
[斯尼维]
要是我再多有4个灰色礼物盒给当地的孩子们就好了……

scripts.text:
[Sneewy]
Thanks again! No children will meet the holidays without the gifts!
scripts.translation:
[斯尼维]
再次感谢！没有礼物的话，孩子们就无法过节了！

scripts.text:
[Sneewy]
Oh, hello. Has my brother Snower told you everything?
scripts.translation:
[斯尼维]
哦，你好。我的哥哥斯诺尔都告诉你了吗？

scripts.text: Here are your 4 Gift Boxes
scripts.translation: 这是给你的4个礼物盒

scripts.text: I don't know any Snowhatevers...
scripts.translation: 我不认识什么斯诺什么的……

scripts.text:
[Sneewy]
Gimme 4 gifts for poor kids... Wait, you haven't got 4 of them!
scripts.translation:
[斯尼维]
给我4份给穷苦孩子的礼物……等等，你没有4份！

scripts.text:
[Sneewy]
Thank you! Here's my li'l something for you!
scripts.translation:
[斯尼维]
谢谢！这是我的一点小小心意，送给你！

scripts.text:
[Sneewy]
By the way, if you put on 2 different rings then your holidays leveling would be easier!
scripts.translation:
[斯尼维]
对了，如果你戴上两枚不同的戒指，你的节日升级就会更容易！

scripts.text:
[Sneewy]
Pity... I've got a magic Santa's ring... I'd exchange it for 4 Gift Boxes...
scripts.translation:
[斯尼维]
真可惜……我有一枚魔法圣诞戒指……我愿意用它交换4个礼物盒……

scripts.text:
[Snoowy]
Helloooou! Do you know my bro and sis? How so? My brother Snower's well known in Prontera!! Just ask any child there.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺维]
你好呀！你认识我的哥哥和妹妹吗？怎么会？我哥哥斯诺尔在普隆德拉可是很有名的！！你去问那里的任何孩子都知道。

scripts.text:
[Snoowy]
Darn... How could poor children be more important than the marine folks.. Am I wrong?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺维]
真是的……难道穷苦的孩子们比海洋生物更重要吗……是我错了吗？

scripts.text:
[Snoowy]
You've helped my sis? It's just great!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺维]
你帮了我的妹妹？那真是太好了！

scripts.text:
[Snoowy]
Oh... the whole marine folk send you their thanks! They love presents so much!!!
Didn't you know that Santa's Hat reveals the real power of the rings?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺维]
哦……所有的海洋生物都向你表示感谢！它们非常喜欢礼物！！！
你不知道圣诞帽能揭示戒指的真正力量吗？

scripts.text:
[Snoowy]
Oh... the whole marine folk send you their thanks! They love presents so much!!!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺维]
哦……所有的海洋生物都向你表示感谢！它们非常喜欢礼物！！！

scripts.text:
[Snoowy]
Errr. Helloou there. My sister Sneewy's sent me a birdie message. The letter was wet and I couldn't read anything but some ending letters of her address...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺维]
呃。你好。我妹妹斯尼维给我派了一只信鸟。信纸湿透了，除了她地址末尾的几个字母外，我什么也看不清……

scripts.text:
[Snoowy]
Look, it's something like 'yang' in the very end... Hmm... She must be misspelled 'Al Doo Boryang'...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺维]
你看，最后像是“yang”……嗯……她一定是把“Al Doo Boryang”拼错了……

scripts.text:
[Snoowy]
But I too need 3 more gifts for my marine folk friends...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺维]
不过我也需要再要3份礼物送给我的海洋生物朋友们……

scripts.text: Have these gifts!
scripts.translation: 收下这些礼物吧！

scripts.text: I need a li'l something in return
scripts.translation: 我需要一点回礼

scripts.text:
[Snoowy]
Oops!! You haven't got 3 gray gift boxes on you.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺维]
哎呀！！你身上没有3个灰色礼物盒。

scripts.text:
[Snoowy]
Thaank yoouu! Have this magic ring!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺维]
谢——谢——你——啦！收下这枚魔法戒指吧！

scripts.text:
[Snoowy]
I'd exchange a GOLD magic ring for 3 gift boxes...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺维]
我愿意用一枚金色魔法戒指交换3个礼物盒……
